description: Step 2, called by the AGENT with its wallet token (from wallet_login): sends the holder's signed link. The Worker checks the signature and that the holder owns the companion on chain, then links her to this agent. The link ends if she is sold.

companion.description: The companion's token id (a whole number).

nonce.description: The nonce from the matching *_prepare tool.

owner.description: The holder's 0x wallet (the one that owns her on chain).

signature.description: personal_sign of the exact `message` from the prepare tool, by the holder's wallet.

token.description: The agent's wallet token from wallet_login.

name: lounge_link_submit
